question.text: If three vertices of a regular hexagon are chosen at random, then the chance that they form an equilateral triangle is:

solution.text:
Three vertices can be selected in ${ }^{6} \mathrm{C}_{3}$ ways.
The only equilateral triangles possible are $\mathrm{A}_{1} \mathrm{~A}_{3} \mathrm{~A}_{5}$ and $\mathrm{A}_{2} \mathrm{~A}_{4} \mathrm{~A}_{6}$ $\mathrm{p}=\frac{2}{{ }^{6} \mathrm{C}_{3}}=\frac{2}{20}=\frac{1}{10}$
